text:
kai: Polaris-v1 int4 bring-up - saw a regression in ja->zh translation quality after q4x or int4 rollout. BLEU down ~7-9 on nightly eval. Posting sample + repro so we can triage.

yasmin: ouch. do you have a diffed output sample? tokenization looks like a prime suspect.

kai: baseline fp16 (prod) vs int4 nightly run (quantized with q4_0 preset). short sample: 

baseline (fp16):
```
Input (ja): 今日は、新しい手順を試してみます。よろしくお願いします。
Output (zh): 我们今天会试验新的流程。请多关照。
```

int4 (polaris-v1-q4_0):
```
Input (ja): 今日は、新しい手順を試してみます。よろしくお願いします。
Output (zh): 我们今天会试验新的流程。请多关照。
```

kai: hmm those look same in rendering but BLEU and chrF show token-level shifts — punctuation and narrow spaces are collapsing in the detokenized output, e.g. fullwidth comma+space becomes merged to single char in many cases. raw detok lines: 

fp16 detok: 我们今天会试验新的流程。 请多关照。
int4 detok: 我们今天会试验新的流程。请多关照。

kai: note the extra space after punctuation disappeared. that yields token alignment differences across many examples and pushes BLEU down.

liam: can you paste the exact eval command and the model/artifact ids? also the tokenizer version used.

kai: eval command: `python eval_runner.py --model polaris-v1 --quant q4_0 --split multilang_ja_zh --detok=redwood-detok-v2 --run-id nightly-17593`
model artifact: `polaris-v1/2025-03-01-q4_0`
tokenizer: `redwood-tokenizer@v1.14.2`

marina: @kai thanks. does the tokenized oracle change or only detok? i.e., is the token stream different pre/post-quant or just postprocessing?

kai: quick check: token sequences for short sample match exactly across fp16/int4 (same token ids). mismatch appears only after our detok step (redwood-detok-v2) when applied to model output tokens from int4 run.

yasmin: that points to detok behavior being sensitive to special token spacing output by sampler (maybe trailing whitespace tokens suppressed by quantized kernel?). two ideas: 1) run detok on token ids (bypass model-side bytes->strings) and compare, 2) re-run with `--detok=legacy-v1` to see if detok impl is the factor.

liam: also try grepping for ZWSP / NBSP / U+3000 in the raw bytes. quant kernels sometimes map whitespace tokens differently under packed embeddings.

kai: did both: token ids identical, but raw string produced by model before detok differs: int4 run returns `　` (IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE) stripped in subsequent detok normalization step for int4 outputs. sample raw dump: 
```
# fp16 raw tokens -> pieces: [..., '，', ' ', '请', '多', '关照', '。']
# int4 raw tokens -> pieces: [..., '，', '　', '请', '多', '关照', '。']
```

marina: interesting — so token stream identical but an extra ideographic-space codepoint appears in model textualization for int4. that suggests our string decoding path for quantized kernels differs. could be kernel-level tokenizer serializer or a fastpath in the runtime.

eval-bot: nightly-17593 eval summary: BLEU_ja->zh: fp16=31.2, int4=23.8, chrF=0.61->0.52, samples flagged=412/3k. Link: https://ci.redwood/internals/evals/nightly-17593

kai: assigning to runtime + tokenizer teams. @marina @yasmin can you start an isolate? if this is reproducible client-side i can share a minimal repro.

marina: will run a micro-benchmark to compare stringifier codepaths: `run_stringifier_bench --model polaris-v1 --quant q4_0 --tokens sample_ids.txt` to diff codepaths between `cpu-stringify` and `gpu-kernel-stringify`. also will check if recent PR that changed fastpath in kernel serializer landed in the q4 build.

yasmin: i'll test `--detok=legacy-v1` and `--detok=redwood-detok-v2 --skip-normalize` to isolate which normalizer removes U+3000. posting results in 30m.

liam: if it turns out to be quant kernel stringifier, we should bisect between kernel versions in the quant build. @deploy-bot can we get a canary with previous quant kernel?

deploy-bot: Canary request received: will schedule a q4_0-canary with kernel rollback to `kernels/2025-02-25` and tag `canary-17593-rollback`. Expected ready in ~45m. 

kai: thanks. i'm also attaching a tiny repro script that hits the same token ids and prints raw codepoints so we can confirm across machines. (pasted in thread Gist)

marina: preliminary bench shows stringifier divergence: cpu-stringify yields `0x3000` token in the same positions only when model outputs are passed through `gpu-kvcache->stringify` path (fastpath enabled). toggling `FASTSTRING=0` in runtime eliminates the ideographic-space insertion and recovers BLEU to fp16 levels in a small sample.

yasmin: confirming detok bypass also recovers BLEU on the sample set. so root cause narrows to fastpath stringifier + quantized kernel interaction.

liam: plan: 1) disable FASTSTRING in q4 canary and re-run nightly subset, 2) start a kernel bisect to find PR, 3) add a unit test that asserts no extra U+3000 insertion for CJK punctuation tokens.

kai: thanks all. if we can get canary results back i'll update the eval dashboard and roll a hotfix on the quant build. adding notes to the onboarding checklist: include stringifier smoke for CJK punctuation when bringing new quant config. :thumbsup:

marina: logging follow-ups in Jira: ML-1842 (stringifier fastpath regression), ML-1843 (unit test + e2e detok smoke).

liam: cc @eng-ml leadership. good find, kai.

kai: will post final canary numbers when deploy-bot finishes.
